text:
```yaml
name: Merge Queue

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Check for merge conflicts
        id: merge-conflict-check
        run: |
          git fetch origin
          git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main || echo "::set-output name=conflicts::true"

      - name: Fail PR if merge conflicts detected
        if: ${{ steps.merge-conflict-check.outputs.conflicts == 'true' }}
        run: echo "Merge conflicts detected. Please resolve them before merging." && exit 1

      - name: Allow merge if no conflicts
        if: ${{ steps.merge-conflict-check.outputs.conflicts != 'true' }}
        run: echo "No merge conflicts detected. Proceeding with merge."
```
